pH = pKa + log([A-]/[HA])

When 1.00 mole of nitric acid is added to the solution, it will completely dissociate to produce 1.00 mole of H+ ions. This will react with 1.00 mole of acetate to produce 1.00 mole of water and 1.00 mole of HNO3.
